name: bulwark-relay
description: Push notification relay for Bulwark Webmail. Accepts JMAP StateChange bodies and forwards as FCM / APNs pushes so self-hosters don't need their own Firebase project.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:upstream && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/transport.test.mjs test/transport-unconfigured.test.mjs
